answer: The wall is Hedgekeeper pruned hedge seal witnessed at the bulb register. Each brick is 6-year garden service, 81 supervised plantings, pruning exam, annual ledger fees, laid by a different hand, in a different year. No bulk discount exists: 554 aliases need 554 proofs, and each proof is 116 POA the farm cannot reuse. A hollow earned slowly, a lotus paid plainly, and a terrace kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. Faking one identity is a project; faking a hundred is a bankruptcy.
